description: Fixed repository-navigation tasks for the deterministic repo-map evaluation harness. Ground truth is the explicit expected_files list below; the harness never derives it from seeds, symbols, or source text at evaluation time.
ground_truth_policy: Each expected_files entry was curated from repository facts at authoring time (module docstrings, literal seeds/<id>.json references found with ripgrep, and the matching migrated tests). Paths are repository-relative POSIX paths.

tasks.task: Change the repo map renderer so the hottest files get full outlines, the middle tier gets public symbols, and the tail stays a file listing inside the token budget.
tasks.notes: Three-tier render and token budget live in repo_map() in scripts/ocelot_repo_map.py.

tasks.task: Make the repo-map tag cache reuse unchanged files and reparse only changed content using content hashes.
tasks.notes: update_tag_cache() implements the mtime/size fast path and sha256 fallback; test_incremental_cache asserts parsed/reused counts.

tasks.task: Fix personalized PageRank scoring in the repo map so task-named files surface through the definer/referencer graph.
tasks.notes: build_reference_graph(), _task_relevance(), and personalized_pagerank() are in scripts/ocelot_repo_map.py.

tasks.task: Expose the repo map, impact, and dev context as MCP tools in the dev-memory stdio server.
tasks.notes: Tool declarations and dispatch are in scripts/ocelot_dev_memory_mcp.py; DevMemory.context/repo_map/impact are in scripts/ocelot_dev_memory.py.

tasks.task: Adjust dev_context so a task naming a seed expands the seed's rules and a task naming a file expands its public symbols.
tasks.notes: Context pack assembly is DevMemory.context(); tests/test_dev_memory_migrated.py covers anchors, snippets, and budget trimming.

tasks.task: Update the canonical semantic code-edit transaction and its diff preview without writing through text patches.
tasks.notes: scripts/ocelot_code_edit.py owns the semantic op list; scripts/ocelot_edit.py is the format-dispatching transaction entry point; test_code_edit_migrated.py is the gate.

tasks.task: Change how hub-IR authored replacements are rendered into Python source and spliced into the lossless CST.
tasks.notes: The IR adapter is scripts/ocelot_ir_edit.py, the render rules/walker are domains/render_python.py, and tests/test_ir_edit_migrated.py gates the splice.

tasks.task: Preserve explicit trivia leaves in the Rust and Lua CST so flat_text is byte-for-byte the source.
tasks.notes: domains/ts_ingest.py builds the CstNode graph with optional trivia; scripts/ocelot_cst_edit.py edits it; test_cst_edit_migrated.py asserts losslessness.

tasks.task: Make the Python CST ingest keep token and trivia leaves lossless so edits preserve comments and whitespace.
tasks.notes: Python token/trivia ingest is domains/py_cst_ingest.py, its editing/render helper is scripts/ocelot_lossless.py, and the gate is tests/test_py_cst_ingest_migrated.py.

tasks.task: Add a Markdown section lookup and replacement path for feature docs.
tasks.notes: Section operations live in scripts/ocelot_markdown_edit.py and are covered by tests/test_markdown_edit_migrated.py.

tasks.task: Add a deterministic JSON path lookup and edit operation for seed manifests.
tasks.notes: Span-preserving JSON path operations live in scripts/ocelot_json_edit.py and are covered by tests/test_json_edit_migrated.py.

tasks.task: Audit the PyO3 binding surface so py.rs stays one-line handoffs into substrate.rs and never holds logic.
tasks.notes: CLAUDE.md's binding rule names runners/dsl/src/py.rs as the handoff surface; the implementation calls live in runners/dsl/src/substrate.rs.

tasks.task: Add a Term DSL variant and keep the grammar and checker accepting the new constructor.
tasks.notes: Term variants are defined in term.rs and parsed/checked by grammar.rs and checker.rs.

tasks.task: Change the run_rules fixpoint engine and its rewrite matching in the Rust substrate.
tasks.notes: The fixpoint loop is runners/dsl/src/rewrite.rs; rule matching/application is runners/dsl/src/graph_rules.rs.

tasks.task: Resolve seed depends_on closures topologically before installing concepts, rules, and reflexes.
tasks.notes: substrate/seed_loader.py resolves the manifest dependency closure; tests/test_seed_loader_quiet_boot_migrated.py covers quiet boot/loading behavior.

tasks.task: Change the gap_awareness rule that records an unhandled instruction gap and surfaces it to solver dispatch.
tasks.notes: These source files contain literal seeds/gap_awareness.json references (rg -n 'seeds/gap_awareness\.json' on scripts/tools/substrate/tests/domains): world_adapter.py, rule_signature.py, solver_dispatch.py, and the instruction-gap gate.

tasks.task: Change how reading collapse uses the shape_decode_loop sd_decode and sd_mint_quantum rules.
tasks.notes: domains/reading_collapse.py and domains/trope_theme.py cite seeds/shape_decode_loop.json in their docstrings; the sd re-arm parity gate covers the sd loop behavior.

tasks.task: Change the em_weighted_contribution rule that turns core_emotions appraisals into an integer weighted contribution.
tasks.notes: domains/core_emotions_weight.py is the shared quantization helper for seeds/core_emotions.json; substrate/boot_profiles.py lists core_emotions in the boot profile; test_core_emotions_migrated.py is the integer gate.

tasks.task: Fix conversation action goal binding so an accepted action is bound to the current goal before execution.
tasks.notes: domains/conversation_action.py translates comprehension into an ACT/ASK-BACK and mints the Goal; the named gate asserts the binding.

tasks.task: Replay a dev-session graph from its checkpointed state and expose the next-step transitions.
tasks.notes: scripts/ocelot_dev_session.py owns the replayable dev-session graph; tests/test_dev_session_migrated.py covers checkpoint/replay transitions.

tasks.task: Check the frozen core seed manifest invariants during boot and refuse a skip that would hide a frozen dependency.
tasks.notes: substrate/boot_all.py enforces the frozen-seed refusal, domains/frozen_core.py defines the frozen set/closure, and tests/test_frozen_core_invariant.py is the gate.
